excluded_packages.debconf-utils: requires Debian debconf and dpkg integration that is not included in the ArkanaOS package base
excluded_packages.rustup: replaces cargo, rustc, rustdoc, and rust debugger paths already owned by arkpkg-repo
excluded_packages.rust-llvm: overlaps rust toolchain paths already owned by arkpkg-repo
excluded_packages.codelite-plugins: depends on a broad wxGTK plugin stack outside the lightweight workstation package set
excluded_packages.dput-ng: overlaps the dput command and documentation already supplied by the dput package
excluded_packages.make-guile: replaces the make executable already owned by arkpkg-repo
excluded_packages.rustfmt: requires the Debian Rust compiler driver ABI, which is incompatible with the existing arkpkg-repo Rust toolchain
excluded_packages.neovim-runtime: duplicates the nvim desktop files, translations, and documentation already owned by arkpkg-repo
